description: Complete machine-specific performance optimization. Combines Ultimate + CPU performance + GPU scheduling + power policy + memory + storage + visual effects. System Restore point created before execution. AC power strongly recommended.

entries.displayName: Ultimate Performance Power Plan
entries.warning: Applies Ultimate Performance power plan. Best on AC power.

entries.displayName: Hardware Accelerated GPU Scheduling (HAGS)
entries.warning: Requires DirectX 12 Ultimate capable GPU and WDDM 2.7+ driver.

entries.displayName: Foreground Application CPU Priority
entries.warning: Biases CPU quanta toward active foreground window.

entries.displayName: Disable CPU Core Parking (AC)
entries.warning: Keeps all CPU cores active. Best on AC power.

entries.displayName: Set Processor Maximum State to 100%
Disable USB Selective Suspend (AC)
entries.warning: Prevents USB devices from entering suspend mode on AC.

entries.displayName: Disable PCIe Active Power Management (AC)
entries.warning: Keeps PCIe links at full power. Increases power consumption slightly.

entries.displayName: Disable Sleep on AC
entries.warning: Prevents system from sleeping on AC power.

entries.displayName: Disable Memory Compression (16+ GB RAM)
entries.warning: Only beneficial on 16 GB+ RAM. Increases working set at cost of page combining.

entries.displayName: Disable Prefetch on NVMe/SSD
entries.warning: Disables prefetcher on SSD where it provides no benefit.

entries.displayName: Visual Effects — Best Performance
entries.warning: Sets Windows to Best Performance visual mode.

entries.displayName: Disable Menu Fade Animation
Workload-Aware Pagefile Optimization
entries.warning: Adjusts pagefile to system-managed. Verify enough free disk space is available.

entries.displayName: Reduce OneDrive Background Priority
Reduce Widgets Background Priority
NVIDIA Max Power Mode (Prefer Maximum Performance)
entries.warning: Enables NVIDIA performance profile via registry. Requires NVIDIA GPU.

entries.displayName: Disable NVIDIA Power Throttling
entries.warning: Sets NVIDIA to Prefer Maximum Performance. Requires NVIDIA GPU.

entries.displayName: After Effects — Process Priority Boost
entries.warning: Only applies when After Effects process is running.

entries.displayName: Expand DirectX 12 Disk Shader Cache to 10 GB
entries.warning: Expands disk-backed shader cache to 10GB to eliminate real-time shader compilation stuttering in modern games and emulators.

entries.displayName: Disable EcoQoS Power Throttling for Virtualization
entries.warning: Completely disables Windows EcoQoS power throttling for Android emulator hypervisors and background worker threads.

entries.displayName: Complete GameDVR Background Video Encoding Suppression
entries.warning: Disables background video capture buffers in GameConfigStore, eliminating encoder overhead and 1% low frame micro-stutters.

entries.displayName: Processor Core Parking Complete AC Unpark (100%)
entries.warning: Forces all logical cores to remain unparked and awake on AC power, eliminating core wake-up latency during sudden gaming bursts.

entries.displayName: AMD Ryzen Dual-CCD 3D V-Cache Core Affinity Alignment
entries.warning: Biases game processes and emulators toward cache-optimized cores on Ryzen 7900X3D/7950X3D processors.

entries.displayName: Intel Thread Director Workload P-Core Prioritization
entries.warning: Locks heavy compute threads to Intel Performance Cores instead of efficiency cores under gaming/render load.

entries.displayName: Disable Nagle's Algorithm for Real-Time Gaming Packets (TcpNoDelay = 1)
entries.warning: Disables packet batching delays to immediately transmit interactive gaming and emulator multiplayer frames.

entries.displayName: High Disk I/O Priority for Creative Render Applications
entries.warning: Assigns High Disk I/O Priority to Adobe After Effects, Premiere, and DaVinci Resolve rendering processes.

entries.displayName: Disable Nagle's Algorithm for Immediate Packet Dispatch
entries.warning: Disables packet buffering delays on the network interface stack for minimum multiplayer latency.

entries.displayName: Reserve Dedicated GPU VRAM Segment for Foreground Applications
entries.warning: Prevents secondary desktop apps from evicting dedicated video memory of the active game or 3D renderer.

entries.displayName: WDDM GPU Command Buffer Preemption Granularity Optimization
entries.warning: Configures GPU driver to finish ongoing draw calls without interruption, boosting average framerates.

entries.displayName: Enable DirectStorage BypassIO Storage Filter Bypass
entries.warning: Allows DirectStorage games to bypass legacy file system filters for instant NVMe texture streaming.

entries.displayName: Set Processor Energy Performance Preference to Maximum Speed
entries.warning: Commands Intel/AMD hardware performance governors to maintain peak boost clock frequencies.

entries.displayName: Enable Windows Variable Refresh Rate (VRR) Globally
entries.warning: Forces G-Sync and FreeSync support for windowed applications and emulators.

entries.displayName: Enforce Fullscreen Optimization Low-Latency Presentation Mode
entries.warning: Enables Hardware Direct Flip presentation for all games, delivering exclusive fullscreen latency in borderless mode.

entries.displayName: Configure MMCSS Games Task Latency Sensitivity to True
entries.warning: Configures the Windows MMCSS engine to mark foreground gaming threads as latency-sensitive for scheduling.

entries.displayName: Optimize Storage Controller Write Cache Buffer Flushing
entries.warning: Informs Windows that drive DRAM write cache is protected, accelerating small 4KB write transactions.

entries.displayName: Calibrate Real-Time Low-Latency Network Socket Pacing
entries.warning: Expands user ephemeral outbound port allocation to 65534 for high-throughput multiplayer matchmaking.

entries.displayName: Suspend Background Search Indexer during Active 3D Workloads
entries.warning: Prevents Windows Search indexing service from consuming disk channel bandwidth during games.

entries.displayName: Eliminate USB Interrupt Polling Jitter on AC Power
entries.warning: Maintains constant high-frequency polling on gaming mice and keyboards.

entries.displayName: Zero Processor Idle Demote Threshold on AC Power
entries.warning: Prevents CPU cores from dropping into high-latency C-states during frame rendering.

entries.displayName: Lock AMD Radeon PowerPlay State to Peak 3D Clocks
entries.warning: Optimizes AMD GPU core frequency pacing while preserving hardware safety limits.

entries.displayName: Synchronize HAGS with Present Queue Latency (1 Frame)
entries.warning: Ensures hardware-scheduled frames are dispatched to display controllers with zero buffer delay.

entries.displayName: Expand StorPort NVMe Storage Adapter Queue Depth to 254
entries.warning: Permits PCIe Gen4/Gen5 NVMe controllers to process up to 254 concurrent I/O queue entries.

entries.displayName: Elevate Windows Memory Zero-Page Thread Execution Priority
entries.warning: Pre-cleans memory pages in idle hardware cycles so memory allocations execute instantly without zeroing latency.

entries.displayName: Configure Heterogeneous Thread Scheduling to Prefer High-Performance Cores
entries.warning: Guarantees games and creative render applications are dispatched to performance cores on hybrid CPUs.

entries.displayName: Disable Deprecated NetDMA Controller Conflict
entries.warning: Prevents legacy NetDMA driver calls from conflicting with modern RSS packet processing.

entries.displayName: Disable DWM Monitor Virtual Refresh Rate Locking
entries.warning: Allows high-refresh displays (144Hz, 240Hz, 360Hz) to render uncapped without desktop composition clamping.

entries.displayName: Elevate WDDM GPU Hardware Queue Scheduling Priority
entries.warning: Gives hardware GPU scheduling priority to active 3D foreground graphics queues.

entries.displayName: High I/O Priority Stream for Video Rendering & Export
entries.warning: Prioritizes media cache and export disk write streams for Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, and DaVinci Resolve.

entries.displayName: Windows Variable Refresh Rate (VRR) System-Wide Boost
entries.warning: Enables OS Variable Refresh Rate for non-native and borderless windowed games, eliminating stutter and screen tearing.

entries.displayName: WASAPI Exclusive Mode Low-Latency Audio Stream
entries.warning: Enables exclusive audio stream buffer mode for low-latency spatial audio in competitive esports.

entries.displayName: Restrict DWM Desktop Window Composition Buffer to 1 Frame
entries.warning: Limits desktop composition queue buffer to 1 frame, eliminating mouse latency in borderless windowed games.

entries.displayName: Enforce NVIDIA Ultra-Low Latency Mode Queue Limiting
entries.warning: Forces 1 pre-rendered frame limit at driver level.

entries.displayName: Uncap Driver-Level Frame Rate Clamping
entries.warning: Removes driver-side frame rate caps for uncapped benchmarking.

entries.displayName: Force Multithreaded Driver Render Dispatch
entries.warning: Dispatches OpenGL and Vulkan render workloads across multi-core CPUs.

entries.displayName: Set GPU Power Mode to Prefer Maximum Performance
entries.warning: Forces GPU clocks to stay at high 3D performance tier on AC.

entries.displayName: Disable VSync Timeout Override for Real-Time Latency
entries.warning: Prevents synthetic VSync sleep yielding in modern DirectX pipelines.

entries.displayName: Enforce AMD CPPC Preferred Cores Autonomous Dispatch on AC
entries.warning: Directs single-threaded game loops to factory highest-binned AMD cores.

entries.displayName: Set Intel Energy Performance Preference (EPP) to 0 (Max Perf)
entries.warning: Forces Intel Speed Shift technology to maximum frequency governor on AC.

entries.displayName: Set Processor Performance Boost Mode to Aggressive on AC
entries.warning: Allows CPU to aggressively sustain all-core turbo boost frequencies.

entries.displayName: Reduce Core Parking Unpark Transition Delay to Minimum
entries.warning: Wakes parked cores in 10ms instead of default sluggish power ramping.

entries.displayName: Enable DirectFlip True Hardware Scanout Bypass
entries.warning: Enables direct hardware scanout presentation bypassing DWM compositor.

entries.displayName: Disable AutoHDR Background Tonemapping Latency
entries.warning: Eliminates synthetic SDR-to-HDR tonemapping overhead during competitive play.

entries.displayName: Disable StorPort NVMe Link Power-Down on Active Loads
entries.warning: Prevents storage host adapter bus power state changes during gameplay.

entries.displayName: Enable I/O Priority Boost on Disk Write Completion
entries.warning: Accelerates game asset loading by boosting thread priority upon read completion.

entries.displayName: Calibrate Initial TCP Retransmission Round-Trip Time
entries.warning: Reduces initial connection handshake wait timeout to 2000ms.

entries.displayName: Reduce TCP Timed Wait Delay for Faster Socket Recycling
entries.warning: Recycles closed game server connections in 30 seconds instead of 120 seconds.

entries.displayName: Configure MMCSS Game Task to Low Latency Mode
entries.warning: Instructs multimedia scheduler to enforce lowest possible buffer latency.

entries.displayName: Configure MMCSS High Clock Rate Interval (10,000 Ticks)
entries.warning: Locks MMCSS thread wake frequency to 10,000 microsecond intervals.

entries.displayName: Enforce MMCSS No-Lazy-Mode Continuous Scheduling
entries.warning: Prevents MMCSS from dropping into low-power lazy scheduling during games.

entries.displayName: Set Virtualization Processor Priority for Android Emulators
entries.warning: Boosts hypervisor CPU slice scheduling for BlueStacks and LDPlayer.

entries.displayName: Enable Direct GPU Access Acceleration for Virtualization
entries.warning: Allows Android emulator virtual machines direct GPU pipeline access.

entries.displayName: Enforce Active Fan Cooling Policy on AC Power
entries.warning: Spins fans to dissipate heat before throttling CPU clock speeds.
